paragraphs.text: For Marvel, this was brilliantly executed, and it’s clear that it was genuinely taken seriously. The story was coherent and the cinematography was really good. I didn’t even notice a bad CGI moment.
I wasn’t a fan of the Ghost character, I just felt like every time she went to use her powers, they switched her powers off rendering her kind of useless.
Really great actors and a funny group; I’m interested to see how they integrate with the rest of the MCU.

The character relationships was really quite good and it was a pretty deep film so I was happy with it. It was a tiny bit long for me so I had to watch it over 3 sittings as my attention span for Marvel films has sort of risen and now dropped again with this challenge.
Overall, it was really good. A serious film that was surprisingly light-hearted when it needed to be, and emotional and deep too. I’m going to give it 4/5. One more Marvel film left before Doomsday!
